title: Recording: Drumming Is My Madness by Ringo Starr | 1980
content:
Compass Point Studios, New Providence, Bahamas
Producer: Ringo Starr

Ringo Starr finished recording ‘Drumming Is My Madness’ for his eighth studio album, Stop And Smell The Roses, on 3 December 1980.

‘Drumming Is My Madness’ was written by Harry Nilsson, who had collaborated with Starr since 1973’s Ringo. The backing track had been recorded on 4 November, and the song was completed with overdubs on 1, 2, 3, and 4 December.
